sheet.title: Set up your account
sheet.body: 5 quick steps so you never miss invitations, reminders or spots in classes.
sheet.footer: You can always find this guide in Profile › Set up account.

card.title: Almost there, so you don't miss invitations

ready.title: You're all set
ready.body: You'll get invitations to classes at your level, reminders before each class and attendance requests, outside the hours you're busy.

alerts.title: Don't miss a spot
alerts.body: When a spot opens, the coach invites several players. Whoever answers first gets it.

items.invites: Invitations to open spots in classes
items.answers: Your coach's answers to your requests

alerts.switchHint: Push and email · you can change it in Preferences
alerts.failed: Couldn't turn them on. Try again.

device.titleIosBrowser: Install the app to get alerts
device.body: So invitations and reminders arrive even with LevApp closed.
device.hintIos: In the iPhone prompt, choose Allow.
device.hintAndroid: In the Android prompt, choose Allow.
device.hintWeb: In the browser prompt, choose Allow.
device.deniedIos: Open Settings › LevApp › Notifications and turn on Allow Notifications.
device.deniedAndroid: Open Settings › Apps › LevApp › Notifications and turn notifications on.
device.deniedWeb: Click the padlock next to the address and set Notifications to Allow.
device.iosBrowserTitle: The iPhone browser has no notifications
device.iosBrowserBody: Safari only delivers alerts to installed apps. Install LevApp and sign in with the same account: your progress stays.
device.appStore: Get it on the App Store
device.unsupported: This browser can't receive notifications. Use another browser or the app.
device.doneBody: Notifications are on for this device.

unavailability.title: When can't you play?
unavailability.body: During those hours you get no invitations or reminders. Pick what looks most like you; you can adjust it later.

coach.title: Connect to your coach
coach.body: Your coach invites you to classes and marks attendance. Without a connection, LevApp has no classes to show you.
coach.linkTitle: Got a link from your coach?
coach.linkBody: Open it on this phone and you're connected automatically. This step completes itself.
coach.noCoachBody: Ask LevApp to connect you to a coach at your club.

profile.title: Waiting on your coach
profile.body: Your level and side are set by your coach. Without them, you get no invitations to classes with a level rule or to spots reserved for one side.
profile.remindHint: Send a reminder. {{coach}} gets it in LevApp.
profile.reminded: Reminder sent to {{coach}}. This step completes when they finish your profile.
profile.allSet: Your coach has set your level and side.

editor.hint1: Tap the hour you become busy.
editor.hint2: Now tap the hour you're free again.
editor.hint3: Tap another hour to add another period.
